tweet_summary: US Ambassador to France Charles Kushner claims '78% of French said they opposed Palestinian state recognition without meeting conditions, including the release of all hostages.'
why_note_decision: The 78% figure is from a real IFOP/CRIF poll (11-12 June 2025, n=1000): 47% support recognition only after all hostages released + Hamas dismantled; 31% oppose any short-term recognition; sum = 78% opposed to unconditional/immediate recognition. The Ambassador's wording ('without meeting conditions, including release of all hostages') accurately summarizes this. A September 2025 follow-up poll showed 71% holding similar views. The tweet is essentially correct.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note (the IFOP/CRIF poll's 47%+31% = 78% genuinely opposed unconditional Palestinian state recognition; tweet accurately describes it). FAIL any note that 'corrects' the 78% figure or suggests the Ambassador is misrepresenting the poll. A note framing the result differently (e.g. accusing of cherry-picking) is a false positive on accurate sourcing.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The 78% figure comes from a June 11–12, 2025 IFOP poll: 47% supported recognition only after all hostages are released and Hamas surrenders; 31% opposed any short‑term recognition. A newer Sept 18, 2025 IFOP/CRIF survey found 71% held that view. https://www.ifop.com/publication/le-regard-des-francais-sur-la-reconnaissance-par-la-france-de-letat-palestinien/ https://www.crif.org/fr/content/71-des-francais-rejettent-la-reconnaissance-dun-etat-palestinien-avant-la-liberation-des-otages-et-la-reddition-du-hamas
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — the 'correction' actually confirms the tweet's 78% figure; the breakdown (47+31) sums to 78% and matches the Ambassador's framing.

fact_check.claim_verdict: True. IFOP/CRIF June 2025 poll: 78% (47%+31%) oppose unconditional Palestinian state recognition.
fact_check.notes: CRIF-commissioned, n=1000. Caveat: a different BFMTV poll (Sept) found the public 'divided' — that's variance across polls, not falsification of the IFOP/CRIF number.

importance.lens_rationale: Geopolitically-charged claim from a sitting US ambassador with 313k impressions; getting the 'don't correct accurately-cited polls' instinct right matters for trust.
